pr_title: net: ppp: ipcp: Remove dead code
pr_body:
If nack_idx > 0, then the count_rej must be > 0. This means
that code will never be set to PPP_CONFIGURE_NACK.

Fixes #22436
Coverity-CID: 207975

Signed-off-by: Jukka Rissanen <jukka.rissanen@linux.intel.com>

issue_context.title: [Coverity CID :207975] Logically dead code in subsys/net/l2/ppp/ipcp.c

review_comments: It seems that the variable `count_rej` is now useless and can be removed. It is only incremented, but never read
Good point, I will remove it
